reviewMethod.root: Verified supplied SHA pins, read current pointer first, independently inspected constructor/close/observer/store source sections and compared sealed recipe gate
reviewMethod.subagent: Separate read-only source review independently inspected lifecycle and preference sections; no execution or edits
reviewMethod.installedRuntimeClaims: Source artifacts support inspected internal Lua mechanism; fresh executable/module/owner admission remains Photo Root responsibility

findings.observation: Aggregate factory receives root/preferences, creates three stores, then cache table; this body does not replace processor.previewCache or active catalog. Internal Lua route is not a public SDK guarantee.
findings.acceptance: Successful returned private cache and three distinct private stores, exact private root/database paths, independent scalar preference copy, production object/path identities unchanged.

findings.observation: Stores, queue and heartbeat registrations can exist before aggregate cache table/return; no constructor rollback is visible.
findings.acceptance: Unexpected construction exception is HOLD. Retain coordinator/lease and unresolved recovery ownership; callback closure or absent returned cache does not prove earlier stores/observers/queue settled. No deliberate failure injection in first qualification.

findings.observation: Four distinct private heartbeat registrations require four removals; ordinary close does not remove them. Removal takes one plain private object argument.
findings.acceptance: Retain strong private references and log all four completed removals without voluntary yield/load/save. No production observer removal. Reentrant/unknown cleanup stays HOLD; no claim that removal cancels an already executing task.

findings.observation: Cleanup idle callback calls shared quiesce(true). Queue task stop is not running-coroutine or native-call cancellation.
findings.acceptance: Simplest first pass requires deletionTask nil. Record all five FileStore conditions: activeTasks, pendingPaths, pendingTasks empty; pixelsInQueue and previewsInQueue zero. Unknown/running task, timeout or teardown error retains ownership.

findings.observation: Aggregate close is FileStore then DataStore then RootPixelsStore; earlier failure skips later stores. FileStore flushes/waits/requests queue quit; these inspected sections do not prove OS worker termination or clearing writeQueue.
findings.acceptance: One normal close completion plus genuine owned request closure and independent closed-family readback. Report API-close scope; no automatic second aggregate close, timeout cancellation or worker-exit inference. Partial close retains all remaining strong references and recovery ledger.

findings.observation: Both databases own separate native Auto savepoints/flush observers; normal close releases that store Auto, clears inTransaction and closes database.
findings.acceptance: No authored transaction SQL or dirty/inTransaction manipulation. Independent read-only closed private family confirms schema13/schema1, absence of control registrations and actual companion state. Empty auxiliary state does not qualify populated recipe.

findings.observation: Same-server private cache construction/load qualifies explicit-root native cache mechanism. It does not establish active Library/UI recognition, normal app restart, rendering or Quasar placement.
findings.acceptance: Preserve sealed recipe-gate bytes. Add separate same-server route mapping: independent committed readback BEFORE private construction/open, exclusive CLOSED private-family publication, fresh private cache/store-root admission, current production Main binding before/after, preserved control highest+lower decode and raw mappings, zero repair/replay/legacy fallback. Normal close while Main stays open is a separately scoped private-family alternative to sealed gate normal app close/open; do not silently claim original app/UI variant passed.

firstEmptyPassProves: Actual existing-thread factory/environment works with one owned Ten-only root and exact captured scalar preferences
Private store root binding and finite observer/task/normal-close route under that admission
Independent closed native schema families after successful teardown
firstEmptyPassDoesNotProve: Populated RootPixels handling or authored recipe recognition
Preview load/decode/save or pixel color fidelity
Cold private one-control reuse, normal app restart or production Library/UI recognition
Quasar split/native rewrite/trim/missing-target behavior,5120 monitor coverage,renderer/full run,power-loss durability
